ImageNet-R-50 two-layer node-latent ablation

A nested representation expansion under the unchanged replay-adaptation matrix.

Finding. The validation-selected two-layer condition is Rotating replay / task-balanced / carry Adam; v6 selected Rotating replay / example loss / carry Adam. Across 16 matched online stage/condition cells, the added layer changes locked-test accuracy by +0.524 points. For the v6-selected condition, the stage-31 and stage-50 changes are -0.157 and +0.217 points.

Exact representation change

The new 768-value class token is captured after the penultimate transformer block while the live node's own LoRA is installed. It is appended after the unchanged 1,369-value slot prefix and normalized separately. New input columns start at zero; all compatible input columns and downstream parameters copy the v6 initialization.

Interpretation boundaries

This is one seed and a test set examined by earlier experiments. Full-history retrains only the integrator and is not online. Integrator validation identities were held out from integrator fitting but not from upstream LoRA-node fitting.
